subject: Mathematics
standard_explanation: A fraction represents a numerical part of a whole quantity or collection. When a single whole object is partitioned into equal divisions, each portion constitutes a fractional unit. For example, dividing an item into two equal sections produces halves (1/2), while dividing it into four equal parts produces quarters (1/4). The numerator denotes the number of parts selected, while the denominator indicates the total number of equal parts comprising the whole.
simplified_explanation: A fraction means sharing fairly. Imagine a round pizza. When we cut the pizza down the middle into 2 equal pieces, each piece is one half (1/2). When we cut it again into 4 equal slices, each slice is one quarter (1/4). All parts must be the same size so everyone gets an equal share!
key_points: A whole is complete and not broken.
One Half (1/2) is 1 piece out of 2 equal parts.
One Quarter (1/4) is 1 piece out of 4 equal parts.
All parts must be equal in size to be a fair fraction.
Putting two halves together makes one whole again.
examples: Cutting a crisp red apple into 2 identical halves to share with a best friend.
A sandwich cut across the middle into 2 equal triangles.
misconceptions: Misconception: Any cut piece is a half, even if one is big and one is small. Fact: Fractions MUST be exactly equal in size.
Misconception: 1/4 is bigger than 1/2 because 4 is bigger than 2. Fact: More pieces mean each individual slice is smaller.

visual_scenes.title: One Whole Pizza
visual_scenes.description: A delicious round, uncut cheese pizza sits on a wooden board. It is one complete whole.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 1: Here is one whole delicious pizza.

visual_scenes.title: Cutting into Two Halves (1/2)
visual_scenes.description: A rolling pizza cutter slices straight through the middle, separating the pizza into 2 equal halves.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 2: Cut down the middle into 2 equal halves (1/2).

visual_scenes.title: Cutting into Four Quarters (1/4)
visual_scenes.description: A second slice creates 4 equal quarter slices. Each slice is 1/4 of the whole pizza.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 3: Cut again to get 4 equal quarter slices (1/4).

visual_scenes.title: Sharing with Friends
visual_scenes.description: Smiling friends each pick up one equal quarter slice, demonstrating fair sharing.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 4: Fair sharing means everyone gets an equal piece!

sign_glossary.description: Non-dominant flat hand forms base; dominant hand slices down across it, indicating a divided portion.
Index finger indicates 1, then drops downward indicating 2 (1 over 2).
Bent open hands tap fingertips together twice at chest height to show identical balance.
Dominant hand rocks back and forth between two open spaces showing equal distribution.

assessment_questions.question: If you cut an apple into 2 equal pieces, what is one piece called?
assessment_questions.hint: It is one part out of two equal pieces (1/2).

assessment_questions.question: How many equal pieces make up one whole when you cut it into quarters?
assessment_questions.hint: Think of a clock or 4 quarters in a whole game.
